Deutsche Bank Ag (DB) Shareholder Continental Advisors Has Lifted Stake by $744,900; University Of Notre Dame Du Lac Increases Stake in Apple (AAPL)
June 20, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
University Of Notre Dame Du Lac increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 24.87% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. University Of Notre Dame Du Lac bought 10,376 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 52,098 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $8.74 million, up from 41,722 at the end of the previous reported quarter. University Of Notre Dame Du Lac who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $917.53 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.53% or $0.985 during the last trading session, reaching $186.675. About 11.49M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500. The hedge fund held 231,300 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.23M, up from 174,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
